invariants: Same original registrar UUID; explicit new epoch; both distinct endpoint receipts bind the same contract and original stop proof.
No task execution, release or acceptance caused by recovery; explicit post-recovery owner release is tested separately.
Original graph edge, binding identity and confirmation retained; old triggers remain unchanged.
Missing proof, mismatched endpoint, stale plan and missing attestation refuse before retirement.
Registrar persistence failure and endpoint audit failure roll back; unchanged plan/attestation retries once.
New records immutable and retained; no H10 artifact-retention migration.
limitations: No physical multi-PC acceptance or deployment.

Imported documents are operator-reviewed local evidence, not cryptographic remote signatures.
No G gate or independent task acceptance is issued.
